trends.name: Iran-Israel Military Escalation
trends.summary: Iran launched retaliatory strikes on Israel and U.S. assets following assassination of security chief Larijani. Russia is supplying Iran with upgraded drone technology, and drone attacks are targeting U.S. diplomatic facilities near Baghdad. This geopolitical flashpoint is driving hedge fund losses and creating oil price volatility.

trends.name: Oil Price Surge & Supply Risk
trends.summary: Brent crude likely to stay elevated around $100/barrel through mid-2026 due to Iran conflict and Hormuz Strait tensions. Airlines like SAS canceling 1,000 flights in April due to high fuel costs. Energy's non-factor status in U.S. CPI could rapidly reverse, impacting inflation expectations and Fed policy.

trends.name: China Real Estate Collapse Accelerates
trends.summary: New home prices in 70 Chinese cities fell 3.2% YoY in February, steepest drop in 8 months. Home prices have now fallen in 44 of last 47 months—longest streak in history. This signals deepening structural weakness in China's economy and property sector.

trends.name: Nvidia Dominance & AI Chip Orders
trends.summary: Jensen Huang confirmed Nvidia has received orders from China and is restarting manufacturing despite geopolitical tensions. CEO called OpenClaw 'definitely the next ChatGPT.' However, GTC showcase barely moved stock, raising questions about valuation expectations already baked in.

trends.name: China AI Companies Rally on OpenClaw
trends.summary: China's 'AI tigers' saw shares surge after Nvidia CEO touted OpenClaw as next ChatGPT. This represents a major sentiment shift toward Chinese AI plays and reflects competitive positioning in generative AI race.

trends.name: Fed Policy & Rate Expectations
trends.summary: Investors awaiting Fed meeting with some calm emerging in rate markets. Asia equities making cautious gains ahead of Fed decision. Bond market sentiment shifting as 'smart money' hates certain bonds that may present buying opportunities.

trends.name: Tesla Battery Supply & EV Economics
trends.summary: Tesla to buy $4.3 billion of LG Energy battery cells from disbanded GM plant, securing critical supply chain. This move strengthens Tesla's battery sourcing amid supply chain pressures and EV industry consolidation.

trends.name: Retail Weakness & Consumer Headwinds
trends.summary: Lululemon reports weak guidance as proxy battle and tariff concerns weigh on margins. Rising gas prices and geopolitical uncertainty creating headwinds for discretionary spending. Consumer health increasingly tied to macro uncertainties.

trends.name: U.S. Venezuela Oil & Sanctions Relief
trends.summary: U.S. moving to ease Venezuela sanctions to unlock additional oil supplies amid Iran war tensions. This is a major policy shift aimed at increasing global oil supply to offset Middle East disruption risk.

trends.name: Robotaxi & Autonomous Vehicle Rally
trends.summary: Uber stock powers higher after Nvidia robotaxi deal helps avert 'doomsday' scenario. AI agents on personal devices (Meta's Manus) and autonomous tech gaining momentum, signaling major sector rotation.

trends.name: Tencent & Chinese Tech Revenue Beats
trends.summary: Tencent's 2025 revenue beats estimates as Chinese tech giant ramps up AI investment. Signals Chinese tech sector finding growth drivers despite macro headwinds and regulatory scrutiny.

trends.name: Defense & Geopolitical Spending Surge
trends.summary: Elbit Systems showing strong execution as Middle East tensions elevate defense spending. Japan-Trump Hormuz security summit and broader geopolitical escalation driving military-industrial demand. Long-term tailwind for defense contractors.
